title: Client segment file (Finspot OMS, Investor Segment)
purpose: Enables each exchange segment for a client login on Finspot: one line per client and Finspot segment (NSE, BSE, NFO, BFO, CDS, BCD, MCX, NCX) the firm trades and the client is registered in, enabled Y when the segment is open (active or reactivated) and N when it is suspended, dormant or closed. The exchange user ID, exchange user info and expiry date are the firm's, per segment, from the Finspot connection. Written for the same clients as the Investor Client file. Lines stop after the six required fields, as in Finspot's sample.

columns.name: NCFM details
columns.note: VARCHAR(50), may be empty; not filled by Ledgerline

columns.name: Days of Warning
columns.note: Numeric, may be empty; not filled by Ledgerline

columns.name: Proxy User Id
columns.note: VARCHAR(20), may be empty; not filled by Ledgerline

source: Finspot File_Formats.xlsx, sheet Investor Segment (9 columns with NOT NULL and lengths; the sample lines stop after the 6 required fields)
